correctness.rationale: For N>=5, two-particle configurations A_j={j,j+1}, B_j={j,j+2} are 2N distinct moving states, with A_j→B_j rate α and B_j→A_{j+1} rate β; all other two-particle configurations are frozen. Fourier blocks have polynomial x²+(α+β)x+αβ(1-e^{iθ}); discriminant vanishes only at θ=π, even N, and β/α=3±2sqrt2. Nonzero nilpotent remainder gives exactly one size-two Jordan block. Exponential of π Fourier block gives the exact F(t), overdamped/oscillatory sign regimes and equal-rate limit. Independently constructed 2N directed-cycle matrices matched spectra at 12 odd/even N and rate pairs. This finite test corroborates, not proves, arbitrary N/rates.
residual_risks: Independent finite checks do not alone prove the claimed all-parameter result; proof-specific bounds established in analytic argument.

evidence: The published active/inactive stochastic ring has active forward hops p, deactivation r and reactivation s with Fourier block [[p exp(iθ)-p-r,s],[r,-s]], unlike this alternating 2N directed cycle with blocks [[-α,α],[βexp(iθ),-β]].
The active/inactive paper has complex-conjugate Jordan pairs on a parabolic three-rate locus; here a sole real Jordan block exists only at parity π and two positive β/α values.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Similar 2x2 non-Hermitian methods do not imply the precise different Markov generator, ratio-only Jordan set or staggered response.
